reviews.title: One the WORST Airlines - for now .....
reviews.text: Treating us passengers (their paying customers) as "inmates" / prisoners on the ground as well as inflight: * requested specifically for AISLE seat but was given MIDDLE. Reminded a few times but the counter male staff kept saying yes yes or rather did NOT CARE or bother at all... * the 2 Male cabin crew were like prison wardens: BRUTE, NO COURTESY, did not bother to say EXCUSE ME etc etc
reviews.author: Coastal557804

reviews.title: Terrible customer service
reviews.text: I have flown with this airline many years ago, and it was nothing impressive but not too shabby. However, I'm trying to book a ticket now and once I put in all passport details on their official website uzairways .com, the confirmation states the first name as last and last name as first. So I didn't book the ticket and called their London office instead. The person I spoke to said "Come to the point - you have made a mistake when booking". I was shocked at this as I used to work on creating User Interfaces for websites and know that websites can have these type of mistakes, and it is up to the customer service representatives to report these. I told him that I haven't booked the ticket yet, however want to make sure the details are recorded correctly by the website because airlines have been known to deny boarding if names are wrong. I told him tha he could go to the website himself and check what happens at the confirmation page before paying. He said he has a different system so doesn't want to do that. I asked him if he wanted to note this to report it. He said no, there is nothing wrong with the website. His manner was very offish, and quite rude. If this is how they deal with customers even before a ticket sale, they probably will care even less about any issues once they have the money. I'm looking at alternative, more reliable airlines now, even if it means a non-direct flight.
reviews.author: MVJG

reviews.title: mrs
reviews.text: Every second passenger is checking in cargo size luggage- tv’s, furniture etc and it takes long time to check in or to receive your luggage. Wifi on board isn’t working. Few entertainment games are just for small children including a game where you need to kill the cats. Main course food and snacks are all with meat. Safety instructions are played on tv like a long fairy tale movie and it wont explain safety measures properly. Could find air fan button above the seat. tickets are unreasonably expensive so visit the country for few days will not worth it its best to buy all inclusive spain\turkey holiday for only the uzb airline ticket price.
reviews.author: erika t

reviews.title: Horrible. Transit area business lounge
reviews.text: I travelled on 16th jan via Tashket. Duirn night transit i had 6 hrs wait so decided to go to the Business lounge since the airport was very cold and had little seating capacity. Lounge entry costed me euros 30. But the lounge was colder than airport. It was like freezing. No heating was available. It was difficult to even sit for fear of freezing. Outside temp was -13degC, inside might be around 3-4degC. The snacks were as cold as frozen. Strangely the receptionist lady and the bar tender had personal heaters and were comfortable whereas I who paid euros had no such heating. I was about to loose my finger tips due to cold and I left the lounge and proceeded to departure. But it was another freezing experience. There was no discpline at gate. It reminded me herd of sheep getting through a door. Until i entered into the plane i was only praying God not to freeze me to death. God save us from such airlines like Uzbekistan Airways!
reviews.author: Mukesh S

reviews.title: horrible airline staff and services
reviews.text: I took Uzbekistan airways flight first time from Delhi for Sochi via Tashkent on 16th Jan 2023. Impression about the airline started right at the checkin counters. Very long que but the staff was extremely lazy. Although they had 7 counters but only 3 were opened. Their Uzbek Manager was only shouting at passengers. Somehow my number came although my legs were full of pain standing in queue for so long. Entered into aircraft, which was a new and beautiful aircraft. But inside cabin services were hopeless due to careless air hostesses. They gave me food, but no water. Dry food got stuck in my throat, i called for water but airhostess replied "later". water never came, so i had to rush to toilet and drank some from tap, saved my life. Never, ever, I will travel by this third class airline.
reviews.author: Mukesh S

reviews.title: Excellent Customer Service from "Helen" at Uzairways London Office.
reviews.text: My review is not about our flight experience with the airline, but outstanding customer service provided in Uzairways London Office by a lady called Helen. I called their London office today (10 January 2022) and Helen answered the phone within seconds. She was very kind and friendly. Anyone could notice that she has an excellent customer service skills, she always tries to help and without a doubt, she has been doing a tremendous job. I have been flying frequently with Uzbekistan Airways since 2003 and have had to deal with the London Office plenty of times. I must admit, the quality of customer service is massively increased in the past couple of years. @Uzbekistan Airways, If you are reading my comment, please deliver my thanks to Helen! She is amazing!
reviews.author: S Shodiyarov

reviews.title: Disaster. Book with another company if possible.
reviews.text: They cancel the flight. They don't give any info at airport (had to discover it through an external web). They don't want to compensate for any lost hotel bookings because of their fault. They don't provide food or lodging for the very long wait. Use another airline or if necessary take a night train, but please do anything possible to avoid them at all cost.
reviews.author: Jrafcb

reviews.title: Cabin crew totally unconcerned about safety
reviews.text: The toddler seated(!) in front of me stood and jumped around on the seat... including during take off and landing; the Ukbek woman seated next to me leant across me to talk through the seat gap with the person in front of her (presumably the toddler's mother) - neither woman wore a seat belt at any time during the flight and trays were left down during take off and landing. The cabin crew paid absolutely no attention. I dread to think what could have happened to the child had we hit bad turbulence at any point.
reviews.author: phebert

reviews.title: A pleasant surprise
reviews.text: I was pleasantly surprised how everything went. We had a smooth check in, the plane was on time, and during the flight we even got some water (in paper cups, on a tray), just like they used to give them back in the old days. The plane does not have any entertainment system, but we did not mind that for a short flight of 1,5 hours. Would fly with them again!
reviews.author: Dzeny

reviews.title: Awful ground experience
reviews.text: Unfortunatelly I bought a Business class ticket from Almaty to Tashkent. Started with the confusing, careless and unpleasant check in agents. They didnt tell where the business counter was, and asked me to change from line to line, until I was on the correct one, but the system didnt work, although for economy it was working. They guy (seemed to be the manager there was extremelly unpleasant and even rude). After passing security, I went to the lounge. Everything was paid there, even water. You were allowed only to have a seat, if you could find one. Many people sleeping on sofas there, taking most of the spaces. Employees there, were also very unkind. Then confusion on checkin, there was no separation for business. Boarding was mixed First Come, First "served", economy or business, who cares? We went on a fully packed bus to the airplane. Another confusion started, the same unpleasant man from checking was there, shouting at everyone, trying to impose how to go up on the the airplane. I have to say: the good thing was inside the plane. Nice service on a 767 airplane. But...... when we arrived, there was a special bus for Business waiting for us. We entered this bus and got locked there. All economy buses left. We were last. Then .... guess what? My luggage with an enormous indication of priority sticked to it took more that one hour to arrive. Nobody from Uzbeq was there.
reviews.author: Gilberto P

reviews.title: Negative experience.. Ticket booked no support
reviews.text: ticket booked, but there is no information on baggage, no webcheck in option available, sent email, twitted for support no response, worst customer support, and at airport abrupt charges.
reviews.author: vimal vizag

reviews.title: Small cramped plane
reviews.text: I was booked on the flights in a tour group. The plane was small, basic and cramped, the kind of thing you would tolerate for a 2 hour flight to Spain, not a long haul flight lasting almost 7 hours. There was no inflight entertainment. The cabin crew were helpful but the food was dire. We took an internal flight from Khiva to Tashkent on a much more comfortable plane so not sure why they don't use these for the long flights.
reviews.author: Celia G

reviews.title: Negative experience
reviews.text: Completely negative experience with this company. I have been trying to contact them for 3 days through their different customer service channels without any response. I have written through the form on their website, I have written to their wassap number and also through instagram. Despite having activity and having contacted them during their opening hours, I have not received any type of response in 3 days. As a result, I was unable to change my flight and had to buy another ticket. Perhaps that was the purpose of not responding, to get me to buy a new flight. Of course, I do not think it is serious for a company that provides a service of this nature, this lack of total customer service. I am very dissatisfied with the treatment, so I leave a record in this way, warning new passengers of the service they may find. Alba Gómez
reviews.author: Alba G

reviews.title: The company didn't refund cancelled tickets
reviews.text: The company didn't refund me the cost of cancelled tickets. The tickets have been cancelled in time by all rules of the company more then 3 months ago. Never fly with the company! They are frauds!
reviews.author: Jack Connel

reviews.title: Uzbekistan  air lounge not great
reviews.text: Checkin etc is great. Unfortunately the lounge leaves much to be desired. Minimal selection of food and apparently a one beer limit. They charge a premium over turkish and I expected more having been in numerous lounges throughout the world.
reviews.author: Chronis

reviews.title: Avoid this monopolistic airline
reviews.text: The flight was delayed for 8 hours without any prior notice. No one responded from customer service to explain why the flight was delayed. No apology as well. Just do not use this terrible monopolistic airline that does not care about its passengers and the management system is still so soviet! Avoid this airline at all costs!
reviews.author: Zohid M

reviews.title: Not too bad
reviews.text: Staff was mildly unfriendly, rest of the service was average. Plane was old and dirty, a lot of drunk passengers onboard and the cabin crew did not seem to care at all. Check in and boarding process without any incident. Food was average.
reviews.author: Jonas

reviews.title: the usual airline but with a perk
reviews.text: Actually I tested both version of Uzbek Airlinse - the discounter and the major. Major which is Uzbekistan Airlines itself which is the usual modern airline with a nice crew and good airfleet. I was really impressed by the usual air safety presentaion they do. It is done in the form of video which is the best I have ever seen. My Oscar goes to the creators of this video. The only thing they need to work on is a list of movies which is very limited. The discounter is Uzbekistan Express also has a nice crew and modern airfleet. There is almost no services and no food provided although my ticket cost roughly the same as for major airline.
reviews.author: Андрей Р

reviews.title: Terrible customer service
reviews.text: So disappointed with the customer service, they could not even bring coffee, when asked. The flight attendants are inattentive to passengers. They are often absent and are usually not responding to calls. Soon I saw most of them lying and sleeping in empty seats at the back of the plane. I do understand long flight is hard and they are tired, it might not be their fault, but the airline company should give them proper rest, as it might put the lives of passengers in danger. The Airport in Tashkent is another story which better not be told.
reviews.author: Frank

reviews.title: Poor customer care
reviews.text: Very disappointed with Uzbekistan Airways service, from boarding until landing in Tashkent. Booked flight with my kids from DXB-TAS on the 7th of November. It started at the airport in DXB, where I requested to get seats in the forward cabin, as it is challenging with small kids to move with luggage all the way to the end of the cabin. The ground staff asked the supervisor called Mr. Khaled (Indian guy) if he could offer us forward cabin seats, Mr. Khaled refused to give us forward seats, as he thought that he is a God and people need to beg him. He was rude not only with me but with poor Filipina ground staff who was trying to tell him the correct procedure, where Mr. Khaled told her "I am Khaled and I am telling you to do it", poor girl felt so embarrassed as he shouted at her in front of all the passengers. He has unacceptable behavior, thinking that he owns the airline and can do what he wants. I have flown many times with Uzbekistan Airways and I have noticed that he has been super rude with passengers and staff at all times (in Dubai and Sharjah) When I came onboard, surprisingly I have noticed that there were so many empty seats in the forward cabin!!! So why did he refused to a mother with 2 small kids to offer a comfort??? I assume he is backed up by someone, because this kind of unacceptable attitude for so many years and nobody takes any action!!! Inflight: - safety was not a priority for cabin crew on this flight, for take off some windows were dimmed, some were b
reviews.author: Maya S

reviews.title: AVOID - THAT'S ALL
reviews.text: The only thing to recommend is that this flight goes direct. On arrival in Tashkent at 0300 my friend had the lock of her suitcase smashed. The baggage handlers stole the expensive birthday present she'd bought for me ... The food is identical flying out and back - hideous extruded chicken formed into a schnitzel. It was the only bad food we had on a ten day trip of Uzbekistan. When came to fly home the entire check in system had crashed meaning we stood at the desk for an extra 1 1/4 hours. First time in my life I've been jokingly referred to as the grandmother of a friend despite being only 25 years older. Misogyny in action ... you forget what it's like. The staff on the plane were quite nice.
reviews.author: TheBeckhams421

reviews.title: Worst airways every
reviews.text: It is impossible to reach customer service. Price tickets are expensive. They cancel flights without explaining the reason. You can't expect more from that monopoly company.
reviews.author: Ogabek Yusupov

reviews.title: No masks
reviews.text: Likeeee, wow. It’s pandemic, the Uzbekistan Airways won’t provide the passengers with masks on the plane. Thankfully the stewardess provided me with her own brand new mask from her personal bag. 10 stars for her kindness. Btw get yourself out of corruption Uzbekistan Airways. Sincerely, Uzbekistan Citizen.
reviews.author: Rasulov M

reviews.title: Pandemic everywhere but not here
reviews.text: In pandemic noone wears a mask. Neither hostes are wearing neither they are controlling passenger whether they are wearing them or not. Requesting them to do so both passengers and hostes facing fail. Won't choose these line ever again.
reviews.author: Гулинур Б

reviews.title: First Time flying to Europe with Uzbekistan Airways Dec2017
reviews.text: Hi everyone, today I'm about to review the Uzbekistan airways that I've been travel with them to the Moscow for the first time. I have not know there is this airlines and I surprise that I chose this airlines to travel with. First of all I found this airlines through skyscaner and is very cheap the ticket was 21,000THB for 2 ways flight, until I book it and so excited to travel, is hard to find the review or information about this airlines. the day has come on my departure day is 22Dec2017 the check in counter at BKK Airport went well. from BKK-TAS there is just about 100 of passenger on board. I'm little upset that there is no In-flight Entertainment No Charger cause it was a B767 with is very old aircraft but that's not the point. The main point is I worry most is about Food and Beverages. I don't if this is a Full-Service airline for Low-cost one. Until the flight attendant serve Hot meal and Drinks I'm very happy that at least they have food service and drinks. the flight attendant on mil flight seems like they look not enjoy and they service like a Slow Life and so chill HAHAHA. about 6 hour of traveling I've got nothing to do and it was my fist time for me to travel with them, so there is no Pillow and Blanket and I don't know if I can request or asking for another drinks and food. but everything is good as fine HAHA. What I like the most Is the Food very delicious and the seat is little bit dirty but all is good, Service is... Baggage Allowance 20KG Seat is free Hot me
reviews.author: Johnson

reviews.title: Staff
reviews.text: Firstly I would like to thank one of staff Kirgizov Mirzo Ulug’bek who was kindly and helpful. It was good flight with you all. And food was delicious. Service is perfect. Thank you so much again!
reviews.author: Fakhriddin M

reviews.title: mr
reviews.text: Worst airline i ever seen and travelled from heathrow to amritsar. No safety, no seat belts for babies, funny thing was staff on airport very rude shoving all passengers in one bus ( overcrowded) for transfer. Lady refused to use other bus as next driver was waiting. Left us outside in rain with baby and told us to wait to get in plane. Will highly not recomended this flight no safety at all.
reviews.author: Satbir S

reviews.title: Holiday in Uzbekistan
reviews.text: The flights were awful. Overcrowded, people stuffed into seats. My seat didn't recline, the one in front of me wouldn't go upright, and I sat in-between 2 large men. Regents, holiday company, was very good. Interesting excursions, good accommodation, good food. Would recommend Regents, but NOT Uzbekistan airlines. Airline staff not approachable either. Airline allowed huge amount of hand luggage, causing chaos and even more overcrowding. On seat entertainment did not work. TVs in hotels were mainly in native language.
reviews.author: petra

reviews.title: Totally hit and miss - hmmmm
reviews.text: You can get either a Dreamliner or an ancient Airbus complete with broken seats - that the ask you to pay more for. Just dont go there if possible.
reviews.author: Ralph M

reviews.title: Surprisingly Good
reviews.text: The flight was short and sweet. Only a soft drink was served on the flight . The air hostess was polite and courteous. The aircraft was clean . This local flight was very good. But on the international sector we experienced the rudeness of a air hostess to a passenger. Their understanding of english was poor !!! The food was average. They were clueless to the difference of an "Indian" veg and non veg meal. Meals were mixed up. They crew seemed disorganised.
reviews.author: bdg
